summary: blavatsky-sd corpus never materialized under corpus/theosophy/ — DB migrated to theosophy but tradition swap never landed on main; graph_bootstrap rebuild would drop all 727 chunks

analysis.author: Hermes Agent
analysis.content: Live data/guru.db: 727 chunk nodes theosophy.blavatsky-sd.001..727 + theosophy tradition node (DB migration cd699484 / todo-4ea3dcc5 was applied to the live DB). main: manifest tradition=western_esoteric, chunking config at chunking/western_esoteric/blavatsky-sd.toml, and ZERO corpus toml for blavatsky-sd. corpus/ is git-tracked (6261 files) and is the source of truth graph_bootstrap.py walks.

analysis.author: Hermes Agent
analysis.content: Chunk BODIES are not in the DB: nodes stores only id/type/label/tradition_id/metadata_json; body lives solely in corpus toml [content].body. So the DB alone cannot regenerate corpus toml; a re-chunk from raw would drift chunk boundaries/ids away from the 727 live nodes, orphaning embeddings/tags/edges. Fix must recover the EXACT toml that seeded the DB, not re-chunk.

analysis.author: Hermes Agent
analysis.content: Root cause: the theosophy tradition swap (feat/blavatsky) was applied to the live DB but never merged to main, and its materialized corpus/theosophy/blavatsky-sd/ was never pushed (origin has 0 of these files; local feat/blavatsky has metadata.toml + 727 chunk toml with ids exactly matching the live DB). RISK: a graph_bootstrap rebuild drops all 727 blavatsky chunks. FIX: land onto main the exact corpus/theosophy/blavatsky-sd/ from feat/blavatsky + swap manifest tradition to theosophy + move chunking config to chunking/theosophy/blavatsky-sd.toml. This reconciles git with the already-live DB; rebuild becomes idempotent and lossless.

resolution.note: Materialized corpus/theosophy/blavatsky-sd/ (727 chunks + metadata) with ids exactly matching the live DB; swapped manifest tradition to theosophy; moved chunking config to chunking/theosophy/. Verified graph_bootstrap rebuild is idempotent/lossless on a DB copy (0 corpus-only, 0 db-only ids).
